briefs.brief_text: Cagliari enters this Serie A fixture seeking to improve upon a winless start to the campaign against a Como side that conceded 3.0 goals per match through their opening two rounds. Como targets their first points of the season while utilizing a high defensive line to disrupt Cagliari's buildup play.

Tyler Herro leads all scorers with 50 points tonight at Xfinity Mobile Arena, yet the Bucks trail the 76ers 130-129 in the fourth quarter. Joel Embiid anchors Philadelphia with 24 points, 17 rebounds, and 9 assists tonight. Herro adds 11 rebounds and 7 assists to his 50 points tonight.

Madison Square Garden hosts this matchup with the Knicks leading 10-2 early in the first quarter. Jalen Brunson’s 5 points tonight pace New York, while Deni Avdija’s 2 points tonight lead Portland. Brunson’s 29.0 PPG this series and Wembanyama’s 28.2 PPG this postseason highlight scoring, while the 107.7 DRTG, best in the NBA this season, anchors defensive play. Wembanyama blocked 3 shots this postseason.

Cooper Flagg leads the Mavericks with 24.2 PPG this season, hosting a Clippers squad featuring Darius Garland’s 21.3 PPG this season. American Airlines Center hosts this matchup, with Garland adding 6.8 APG this season while Rui Hachimura grabs 6.0 RPG this season. KFAA-TV broadcasts the game tonight.

Ty Jerome leads the Grizzlies with 25.4 PPG this season, while Ayo Dosunmu averages 17.8 PPG this season for the Timberwolves. Cedric Coward grabs 8.1 RPG this season to counter Rudy Gobert’s 10.9 RPG this season. Cam Spencer records 5.8 APG this season, slightly edging LaMelo Ball’s 5.7 APG this season at Target Center.

Victor Wembanyama leads the Spurs into the Frost Bank Center averaging 28.6 PPG and 11.9 RPG this season. He faces a Pelicans squad featuring Saddiq Bey, who averages 16.8 PPG this season. Stephon Castle facilitates the San Antonio offense with 5.9 APG this season, while Jeremiah Fears contributes 5.4 APG this season.

Darius Acuff Jr. leads the Kings with 25.7 PPG this season, while Paul George paces the Celtics with 19.9 PPG this season. Golden 1 Center hosts this matchup broadcast on NBA TV. Domantas Sabonis averages 13.4 RPG this season, contrasting with Neemias Queta’s 6.9 RPG this season.

Andrei Svechnikov leads the Hurricanes with 2 goals tonight, helping Carolina hold a 6-4 lead over Edmonton with 5:21 remaining in the third period. Sebastian Aho contributes 3 points tonight, while Leon Draisaitl records 1 goal tonight and Connor McDavid tallies 2 assists tonight for the Oilers at Lenovo Center.

Blackhawks and Flames remain deadlocked at 3-3 with 13:17 remaining in the third period at Scotiabank Saddledome. Ryan Strome leads Calgary with 1 goal and 1 assist tonight, while Patrick Kane records 1 goal and 1 assist tonight for Chicago. Sam Rinzel contributes 2 assists tonight for the Blackhawks.

Sam Bennett leads the Panthers with 2 goals and 2 points through 40 minutes of play tonight at Amerant Bank Arena. Jiri Kulich scored 1 goal and Jack Quinn added 1 point through 40 minutes for the Sabres. The teams remain tied 2-2 through 40 minutes of this NHL season.

Washington leads Boston 2-1 after one period at TD Garden on ESPN+. Tom Wilson recorded 1 goal tonight, while Elias Lindholm tallied 1 goal tonight for the Bruins. Boone Jenner added 1 assist tonight for the Capitals, matching David Pastrnak, who registered 1 assist tonight for Boston.

Pittsburgh and Nashville enter the third period tied 3-3 at Bridgestone Arena on ESPN+. Jonathan Marchessault leads Nashville with 1 goal and 2 points tonight, while Brady Skjei adds 2 assists tonight. Hendrix Lapierre recorded 1 goal tonight for Pittsburgh, supported by 1 assist from Kaedan Korczak tonight.

Scotiabank Arena hosts this scoreless matchup between the Blue Jackets and Maple Leafs with 19:38 remaining in the first period. Anthony Stolarz starts in net for Toronto, while Cam Talbot guards the crease for Columbus. ESPN+ broadcasts this contest as both teams seek their ninth win this season.

St. Louis leads New Jersey 4-2 early in the first period at Enterprise Center on ESPN+. Philip Broberg tallied 1 goal and 3 points tonight, while Jake Neighbours recorded 3 assists tonight. Timo Meier scored 1 goal tonight, and Brett Pesce added 2 assists tonight for the Devils.

Oliver Kapanen and Christian Dvorak each scored 1 goal tonight at the Bell Centre to keep the Flyers and Canadiens tied at 1-1 early in the first period. Travis Konecny recorded 1 assist tonight, while Brett Berard contributed 1 assist tonight. Jacob Fowler and Dan Vladar start in net tonight.

Mitch Marner and Adam Lowry traded goals early in the first period at Canada Life Centre. The Golden Knights lead 2-1 with 4:37 remaining in the opening frame. ESPN+ broadcasts this matchup between the 13-6-5 Golden Knights and the 11-9-3 Jets as both teams battle for early positioning tonight.

Clayton Keller leads Utah with 29 points this season, while Cutter Gauthier matches that total with 29 points this season. Sebastian Cossa faces Ville Husso at Delta Center tonight. Gauthier recorded 21 goals this season, and Logan Cooley notched 11 goals this season. This matchup features 3 shots on goal per player average tonight.

Mats Zuccarello leads the Kings with 1 goal and 1 point tonight at Canadian Tire Centre. Los Angeles holds a 1-0 lead over Ottawa through 11:05 of the first period. Linus Ullmark starts in goal for the Senators, while Anton Forsberg defends the net for the Kings on ESPN+.

Kirill Kaprizov leads the Wild this season with 43 points, while Brock Boeser paces the Canucks with 24 points this season. Jesper Wallstedt starts in net for Minnesota against Leevi Merilainen for Vancouver at Rogers Arena. ESPN+ broadcasts this matchup between the Wild and the Canucks tonight.

Emmitt Finnie leads the Red Wings 1-0 after recording 1 goal and 1 point through the first period tonight at Little Caesars Arena. The Islanders trail while facing Ilya Sorokin, who saved 3 shots through the first period. John Gibson guards the net for Detroit as ESPN+ broadcasts this matchup.

Fulham held Manchester City to a 1-1 draw at the Etihad Stadium, defying pre-game odds that closed at -270 for the home side. Manchester City moved to 7-3-1 this season, while Fulham shifted to 2-5-4 this season. USA Net broadcast this result between the two Premier League clubs.

Macklin Celebrini leads San Jose with 9 goals, 18 assists, and 27 points this season, while Berkly Catton paces Seattle with 8 goals and 17 points this season. Alex Nedeljkovic and Philipp Grubauer start in goal at SAP Center. ESPN+ broadcasts this matchup tonight.

Ipswich fell to a 2-0 defeat against Spurs at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, failing to convert any of their chances this match. Spurs improved their record to 5-3-4 this season, while Ipswich dropped to 3-2-7 this season. The home side maintained their -200 closing odds throughout this match on USA Net.

Bournemouth closed as +110 favorites, while Nottingham Forest closed as +265 underdogs in this Peacock broadcasted match.

Arsenal and Newcastle finished in a 2-2 draw at St. James' Park on USA Net. Arsenal entered the match with a 9-1-1 record this season, while Newcastle held a 3-4-4 record this season. Closing odds favored the visitors at -190 compared to +500 for the home side.

Deportivo recorded 3 shots this match, trailing Alavés’ total output this match. ESPN Deportes broadcasts this second-half action live.

Aston Villa entered this match with a 3-5-3 record this season, while Sunderland held a 2-3-6 record this season. The home side closed as -140 favorites against the +370 away side.

New England holds a 2-0 lead over Philadelphia at Gillette Stadium as the match enters the final moments of stoppage time. New England secured both goals tonight to command the result. Apple TV broadcasts this match as Philadelphia fails to find the net through 90 minutes of play tonight.

Valencia leads 1-0 at Estadio de Vallecas in the 71st minute of this La Liga match. Valencia holds a 2-3-7 record through 12 games this season, while Rayo enters with a 3-3-5 record through 11 games this season. ESPN Deportes broadcasts this second-half action live from Madrid.

Closing odds favored Chelsea at -105, yet the visitors dominated the scoreboard to finalize this result.

Dallas leads Portland 2-0 at Toyota Stadium in the 63rd minute of tonight’s match. Apple TV viewers watch Dallas maintain a two-goal advantage during this second half. Portland struggles to generate offense against the Dallas defensive structure tonight. Both clubs continue to battle for possession throughout this second half.

Betis leads 1-0 at the Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán Stadium in the 68th minute of this match. Betis holds an 8-2-2 record through 12 games this season, while Sevilla carries a 5-3-4 record through 12 games this season. ESPN Deportes broadcasts this second-half action as the visitors protect their narrow lead.

Coventry secured a 3-2 victory over Crystal Palace at the Coventry Building Society Arena, improving their record to 4-0-7 this season. Crystal Palace fell to 2-1-8 this season despite the Peacock broadcast. Coventry rewarded bettors who backed them at +150 odds this match, while the away side failed at +175 odds.

Columbus converted 3 shots on target tonight to build their current lead while Miami remains scoreless through 74 minutes of play tonight.

Fandango broadcast the match as Dortmund maintained their position near the top of the table while Gladbach struggled to find an equalizer throughout the full 90 minutes.

Paramount+ broadcast this match, which saw the home side secure a clean sheet against a Cagliari attack that struggled to find the net tonight.

Napoli holds a 1-0 lead over Torino in the 87th minute at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona. Napoli enters this match with a 4-3-4 record this season, while Torino carries a 4-2-5 record this season. Paramount+ broadcasts this Serie A contest as the clock ticks toward the final whistle.

Frankfurt defeated Hoffenheim 1-0 at Deutsche Bank Park to improve their record to 5-3-3 this season. Hoffenheim fell to 4-0-7 this season after failing to score tonight. Frankfurt closed at +145 odds tonight, matching their opening price, while Hoffenheim also closed at +145 odds tonight.

Stade Bollaert-Delelis remains deadlocked at 1-1 in the 59th minute as Toulouse and Lens trade goals. Fox broadcasts this matchup as the Cornhuskers attempt to protect their narrow advantage against the Buckeyes in Lincoln.

The Eagles overcame their underdog status as +130 home underdogs to finish this game with a 12-point margin. Syracuse dropped to 5-6 this season after failing to overcome the Boston College defense during this ACC Network broadcast.

RB Leipzig dismantled Union Berlin 5-1 at Stadion An der Alten Försterei, improving their record to 7-0-3 this season. Union Berlin fell to 1-4-5 this season despite closing as +475 underdogs. Leipzig bettors cashed at -220 odds this match, as the visitors overwhelmed the hosts with five goals tonight.

Freiburg defeated Elversberg 1-0 at URSAPHARM-Arena an der Kaiserlinde, moving to a 7-1-2 record this season. Elversberg fell to 4-1-5 this season despite closing as +245 underdogs. Fandango broadcast the match as the visitors maintained their superior standing in the Bundesliga table.

The SEC Network broadcast captured the Gators holding off the Commodores despite the betting market closing with Florida as a -535 favorite tonight.

Northwestern and Minnesota remain deadlocked at 17 points through 59 minutes and 57 seconds of play tonight at Huntington Bank Stadium. Both teams have struggled to pull away in this Big Ten matchup. FS1 broadcasts the final seconds as the clock ticks down to zero in the fourth quarter.

Tulane leads North Texas 28-24 with two minutes remaining in the fourth quarter at Yulman Stadium on ESPNU. Tulane holds this four-point advantage tonight while North Texas attempts a late comeback. Both teams entered this contest with North Texas at 7-3 this season and Tulane at 5-5 this season.

Leverkusen cruised to a 4-0 victory over Paderborn at BayArena, moving their record to 6-1-3 this season while dropping Paderborn to 2-4-4 this season. Closing as -350 favorites, the hosts controlled the match throughout. Fandango broadcast the shutout as Leverkusen improved their standing in the Bundesliga table this season.

Wisconsin dominates Purdue 42-10 at Ross-Ade Stadium with 1:26 remaining in the fourth quarter on NBC. Wisconsin improves to 7-4 this season while Purdue falls to 3-8 this season. The Badgers offense consistently converts drives into points tonight, while the Boilermakers defense allows 42 points tonight.

Virginia clinched bowl eligibility tonight at Scott Stadium by defeating North Carolina 41-24. The Cavaliers gained 41 points tonight while holding the Tar Heels to 24 points tonight. Virginia closed as a -118 favorite tonight, matching the opening line, while North Carolina closed as a -102 underdog tonight.

Alabama shut out Chattanooga 47-0 at Bryant-Denny Stadium in this game. The Crimson Tide improved their record to 10-2 this season, while the Mocs finished their campaign at 7-6 this season. Alabama held Chattanooga to zero points this game while scoring 47 points this game to secure the shutout victory.

BYU and Kansas remain deadlocked at 29-29 as time expires at David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium. BYU enters this matchup with an 8-2 record this season, while Kansas holds a 4-6 record this season. ABC broadcasts this game live as both teams conclude their offensive efforts in this contest.

PSG defeated Nice 3-2 at Allianz Riviera in this Ligue 1 match broadcast on beIn Sports. PSG improved to 9-2-1 this season, while Nice fell to 5-2-4 this season. Closing odds held steady at +475 for the home side and -210 for the away side throughout this match.

Cincinnati leads Colorado 35-28 with 0:17 remaining in the third quarter at Nippert Stadium. Cincinnati currently holds a seven-point advantage tonight on ESPN+ while seeking to improve upon its 5-5 record this season. Colorado trails by one touchdown tonight after struggling to contain the Cincinnati offense throughout this game.

East Carolina leads Army 10-6 with 3:31 remaining in the fourth quarter at Michie Stadium. East Carolina holds a four-point advantage tonight while Army struggles to find the end zone during this matchup. CBSSN broadcasts this final drive as the Pirates attempt to protect their lead through the closing minutes tonight.

Tulsa dominates Charlotte 42-14 late in the fourth quarter at H. A. Chapman Stadium on ESPN+. Tulsa secures this win by scoring 42 points tonight, while Charlotte manages only 14 points tonight. Tulsa improves its record to 6-4 this season, while Charlotte falls to 1-9 this season in this matchup.

Houston and West Virginia remain deadlocked at 31-31 with 4:31 remaining in the fourth quarter at Milan Puskar Stadium. TNT broadcasts this Big 12 matchup as both teams fight for late-game positioning. Houston enters this game with a 7-3 record this season, while West Virginia holds a 5-5 record this season.

Memphis leads Navy 34-31 with 5:10 remaining in the fourth quarter at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium on ESPN2. Memphis holds a 34-31 lead in this game while Navy trails 31-34 in this game. The teams combined for 65 points in this game, and the quarterbacks attempted 3 shots in this game.

Mississippi State entered the matchup as heavy favorites with -3600 odds tonight, while Tennessee Tech carried +1500 odds tonight. Jacksonville State leads Missouri State 25-20 with two minutes remaining in the fourth quarter at AmFirst Stadium. The Gamecocks hold this five-point edge tonight while broadcasting on ESPN+. Missouri State currently trails by five points tonight as they attempt a final scoring drive to overcome the deficit in this matchup.

FAU holds a 28-point advantage tonight, significantly outpacing South Florida’s 7 points tonight. ESPN+ broadcasts this matchup between two 6-4 teams. Officials paused the game at the 6:25 mark of the second quarter.

Middle Tennessee State leads Sam Houston 31-28 with 4:29 remaining in the fourth quarter at Elliott T. Bowers Stadium on ESPN+. The Blue Raiders hold this three-point edge tonight as they attempt to secure their sixth win this season. Sam Houston trails by three points tonight while seeking their second victory this season.

Liberty holds a 45-14 lead over Western Kentucky with two minutes remaining in the fourth quarter at Williams Stadium. Liberty improved to 10-1 this season with this performance, while Western Kentucky fell to 4-7 this season. ESPN+ broadcasts this matchup as the clock winds down in Virginia.

UL Monroe and App State remain deadlocked at 10-10 through the first half at Kidd Brewer Stadium. The Warhawks enter this matchup with a 2-8 record this season, while the Mountaineers hold a 6-4 record this season. ESPN+ broadcasts this Sun Belt conference contest as play continues tonight.

Iowa improved to 10-2 this season by defeating Illinois 34-17 tonight at Gies Memorial Stadium. The Hawkeyes covered the -325 moneyline odds offered this game while the Fighting Illini fell to 6-6 this season. Iowa maintained control throughout the contest to secure this road win on BTN.

UCLA and Michigan remain deadlocked at 13-13 as the clock hits 0:00 in the sixth period at Michigan Stadium. Both teams struggle to find the end zone tonight after scoring 13 points each through this game. CBS broadcasts this intense defensive struggle as the stalemate continues into overtime.

Delaware leads New Mexico State 35-24 with 2:03 remaining in the fourth quarter at Aggie Memorial Stadium. Delaware holds an 11-point advantage tonight while seeking its sixth win this season. New Mexico State trails by double digits tonight as it attempts to avoid its eighth loss this season.

Texas commands a 45-3 lead over Arkansas with 7:31 remaining in the fourth quarter at DKR-Texas Memorial Stadium. Texas maintains this 42-point advantage tonight while Arkansas struggles to generate offense. ESPN broadcasts this SEC matchup as the Longhorns move toward their ninth win of this season.

Tennessee leads LSU 27-13 with 4:03 remaining in the fourth quarter at Neyland Stadium on ABC. Tennessee holds a 14-point advantage tonight while LSU struggles to bridge the gap late. The Volunteers maintain their lead through this fourth quarter, forcing LSU to execute quickly to overcome the deficit before time expires.

NC State defeated Florida State 28-10 tonight at Doak Campbell Stadium despite closing as 395-point underdogs. The Wolfpack offense capitalized on defensive lapses to secure the road win, while the Seminoles struggled to generate points throughout this game. Both teams now hold identical 5-6 records through this season.

Texas Tech leads Baylor 17-10 in the third quarter at McLane Stadium on Fox. Texas Tech holds a 17-10 advantage in this game, while Baylor trails 10-17 in this game. The visitors currently control the pace of this conference matchup as the clock winds down in the third period.

The Bison relied on a steady offense to overcome the Huskies' winless 0-11 record this season. North Dakota State closed as -3200 favorites tonight, while Northern Illinois entered the contest as +1400 underdogs tonight.

Kentucky enters this matchup with a 7-3 record this season, while Missouri holds a 6-4 record this season. Stanford enters this game with a 5-5 record this season, while California holds a 3-7 record this season. Both teams currently seek their next scoring drive.
